# Pin assignments

<!-- GENERATED by hardware/tools/gen_pins.py --docs from hardware/pins.yaml. Do not edit. -->

MCU: **STM32U083KCU6**, package UFQFPN32. The firmware uses these
assignments through the generated `firmware/port/stm32u0/pins.h`; unused GPIOs are
configured as analog inputs for the lowest leakage.

| Pin | Name | Net | Function | Notes |
|-:|-|-|-|-|
| 1 | VDD | VBAT | power |  |
| 2 | PC14 | - | unused (analog) | spare (LSE pins unused; RTC is external) |
| 3 | PC15 | - | unused (analog) | spare |
| 4 | PF2 | NRST | reset | NRST, 100 nF to GND, Tag-Connect J3, test pad TP5 |
| 5 | VDDA | VBAT | power | battery voltage measured via VREFINT |
| 6 | PA0 | JOY_CENTER | GPIO input, pull-up, EXTI wake | joystick push (WKUP1) |
| 7 | PA1 | JOY_A | GPIO input, pull-up, EXTI wake | joystick direction A |
| 8 | PA2 | JOY_B | GPIO input, pull-up, EXTI wake | joystick direction B |
| 9 | PA3 | JOY_C | GPIO input, pull-up, EXTI wake | joystick direction C |
| 10 | PA4 | EPD_CS | GPIO output | e-paper chip select (GPIO) |
| 11 | PA5 | EPD_SCK | AF5 | SPI1_SCK |
| 12 | PA6 | EPD_DC | GPIO output | e-paper data/command |
| 13 | PA7 | EPD_SDI | AF5 | SPI1_MOSI |
| 14 | PB0 | EPD_RST | GPIO output | e-paper reset, active low |
| 15 | PB1 | EPD_BUSY | GPIO input | e-paper busy, high = busy (SSD1680) |
| 16 | VSS | GND | ground |  |
| 17 | VDD | VBAT | power | VDD/VDDUSB, own 100 nF |
| 18 | PA8 | EPD_PWR_N | GPIO output | e-paper load switch, low = on |
| 19 | PA9 | IR_TX | AF7 | USART1_TX, inverted (idle = LED off) |
| 20 | PA10 | IR_RX | AF7 | USART1_RX, inverted |
| 21 | PA11 | IR_RX_PWR | GPIO output | powers the phototransistor |
| 22 | PA12 | - | unused (analog) | spare |
| 23 | PA13 | SWDIO | SWD (AF0) | SWD, Tag-Connect J3, test pad TP3 |
| 24 | PA14 | SWCLK | SWD (AF0) | SWD, Tag-Connect J3, test pad TP4 |
| 25 | PA15 | JOY_D | GPIO input, pull-up, EXTI wake | joystick direction D |
| 26 | PB3 | - | unused (analog) | spare |
| 27 | PB4 | RTC_INT | GPIO input, pull-up, EXTI wake | RV-3032 INT, open drain |
| 28 | PB5 | - | unused (analog) | spare |
| 29 | PB6 | I2C_SCL | AF4 | I2C1_SCL, 4.7k pull-up |
| 30 | PB7 | I2C_SDA | AF4 | I2C1_SDA, 4.7k pull-up |
| 31 | PF3 | BOOT0 | boot select | BOOT0, 10k pull-down |
| 32 | VSS | GND | ground |  |
| 33 | EP | GND | ground | exposed pad |

## Joystick directions

The five-way switch sits at 45 degrees on the board; seen from the front with the
screen upright the contacts map to:

| Direction | Net | MCU pin |
|-|-|-|
| up | JOY_B | PA2 (pin 8) |
| right | JOY_D | PA15 (pin 25) |
| down | JOY_C | PA3 (pin 9) |
| left | JOY_A | PA1 (pin 7) |
| center | JOY_CENTER | PA0 (pin 6) |
